options.description: What a relative link is resolved against, such as the repository a README came from. Without one a relative link is not a hyperlink -- a terminal has nothing to resolve it against -- and its path is shown beside its words.
options.name: baseUrl

options.description: The environment to read the terminal from. Defaults to `process.env`.
options.name: env

options.description: Says which stretches of a code block are which tokens, for syntax highlighting -- the hook `diff()` and `multiline()` take, with the block's language beside the code.
options.name: highlight
options.type: (code: string, lang: string | undefined) => readonly HighlightSpan[]

options.description: Whether a link is an OSC 8 hyperlink, with its URL out of sight, or its words with the URL after them. Defaults to `supportsHyperlinks()` for `stream`, and is always the second at colour level 0, which writes no escape sequence.
options.name: hyperlinks

options.description: The platform to detect for. Defaults to `process.platform`.
options.name: platform

options.description: The stream the output is bound for. Defaults to `process.stdout`.
options.name: stream

options.description: The columns to wrap at. Defaults to `terminalWidth()`, never under 10.
options.name: width

api.signature: function markdown(source: string | readonly MarkdownBlock[], opts?: MarkdownOptions): string
